#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
const long long MOD = 1000000007;
long long p, k;

long long fast_pow(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long current = base;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * current) % MOD;
        current = (current * current) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fast_pow(p, p - 1) << endl;
    } else if (k == 1) {
        cout << fast_pow(p, p) << endl;
    } else {
        long long cycle_length = 1;
        long long position = k % p;
        while (position != 1) {
            position = (position * k) % p;
            ++cycle_length;
        }
        long long count = (p - 1) / cycle_length;
        cout << fast_pow(p, count) << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
